subject.title: feat(android): add staged Wear status bridge

question: Should this Wear module merge as intentionally source-only staged work, or must the publishable versioning and release path be completed in this PR?
rationale: The runtime slice is technically bounded, but current Android release tooling has one phone version identity and no Wear artifact path; choosing a permanent multi-form-factor release contract requires Android release-owner intent.

options.title: Require release contract first
options.body: Define a unique Wear versionCode scheme plus archive, signing, preflight, and upload expectations before merging the new application module.

options.title: Accept staged source-only module
options.body: Merge the runtime and CI slice with an explicit decision that no official Wear artifact is publishable until separately sponsored release work lands.

options.title: Pause Wear product work
options.body: Close or pause the PR until maintainers sponsor an official Wear companion and its long-term distribution surface.

recommendation.title: Require release contract first
recommendation.body: Define a unique Wear versionCode scheme plus archive, signing, preflight, and upload expectations before merging the new application module.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history concentrates Android versioning, signing, Play upload, and release-preflight ownership with this contributor.
